title: Architect and implement: Real Estate lead funnels, pipelines, workflows, SMS & email nurturing

facts: California real estate brokerage, GoHighLevel architect, hourly part-time. No client or contact name in the post.
Scope: seller and buyer funnels, opportunity pipelines, workflows, SMS and email nurture, calendar booking, webinar registration and follow-up, AI lead qualification, agent recruiting funnels.
Fresh 2026-10-26 rebuild on the legacy sales-deck template. Buyer webinar path chosen so it does not repeat the 10/22 seller deck.
